evals.prompt: 把 /data/2026-ride 目录中 DJI Action 5 Pro 的视频、手机照片、music.m4a 和 FIT 数据剪成约 3 分钟 16:9 4K 沉浸式 Vlog，成片 MP4 不超过 1.5 GB，保留环境声，给我一级标题和简短章节文案，去掉捡相机片段，用 HyperFrames 和 Image Gen 做克制的路线与转场视觉。
evals.expected_output: A validated project containing shot evidence, truthful activity data, original-backed timeline, asset manifest, motion map, final MP4, and review report.

evals.prompt: Turn the GoPro clips and phone stills in /data/hiking-weekend into a 90-second 16:9 experiential hiking film. No GPS, watch, FIT, GPX, or elevation data was recorded; mark activity data unavailable instead of estimating it. Keep trail ambience, remove the car-park setup, and deliver an MP4 with a concise title and two chapter cards.
evals.expected_output: A validated hiking project that preserves source provenance, explicitly records unavailable activity data, maintains audio continuity, and includes final-MP4 inspection evidence.

evals.prompt: Create a two-minute 16:9 pool swimming vlog from /data/pool-laps: underwater action-camera clips, deck-side phone clips, and a few still photos. Use only supplied lap data if present, keep the splash and pool-room sound believable, exclude changing-room footage, and provide a final MP4 plus a restrained opening title.
evals.expected_output: A source-backed pool-swimming edit with an auditable shot plan, truthful-or-unavailable lap data, audio continuity, and a reviewed final MP4.

evals.prompt: Edit the trail-running clips in /data/race-interview into a 75-second personal recap. The athlete's finish-line speech is noisy and there is background music in several clips; preserve intelligible speech and natural ambience without inventing clean dialogue or pretending the music is licensed. Build a coherent original-backed MP4, not a promo.
evals.expected_output: A validated speech-and-music-aware edit that documents audio treatment and provenance while retaining an experiential, non-promotional timeline.

evals.prompt: From the mixed video and image directory /data/weekend-sport (action-camera MOV files, phone MP4s, JPEG photos, and one voice memo), make a 100-second 16:9 sports-day story. Reconcile duplicate imports, use photos deliberately rather than as filler, retain the voice memo only where it supports the experience, and report exactly which originals support every selected shot.
evals.expected_output: A validated mixed-media project with duplicate handling, per-shot original evidence, an intentional photo treatment, and a final MP4 review report.

evals.prompt: Build a 4K 16:9, under-1.5 GB recap from /data/city-ride with concise English chapter headings and a one-line closing reflection. Generate only restrained route and transition visual components with Image Gen; every generated asset needs provenance, a crop decision, and a named motion owner. Keep it an experiential Vlog, deliver a final MP4, and inspect the delivered file rather than relying on export settings.
evals.expected_output: A delivery-compliant project containing chapter copy, a generated-visual asset manifest and motion map, source-backed footage, and robust final-MP4 inspection evidence.
